title: 같이는 왜 [가치]예요? 입천장소리 되기
objective: By the end, you can read words like 같이, 굳이 and 해돋이 aloud with the right sound, and tell when ㄷ·ㅌ change before 이 and when they do not.
summary: Learn why final ㄷ and ㅌ sound like [ㅈ] and [ㅊ] before 이, as in 같이 [가치] and 굳이 [구지].

task.title: Read and write the sounds
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then write or choose how it really sounds in [ ].

words.meaning: go out of your way to; bother to
words.exampleMeaning: You don't need to bother buying it.
We watch the sunrise at the sea.

letters.sound: Final ㄷ before 이 moves over and becomes ㅈ.
Final ㅌ before 이 moves over and becomes ㅊ.
With other vowels such as 아, 어, 에, 으 (as in 같아요, 밭에, 밭을), the final consonant just links over.

exercises: Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 미닫이 ② 밑이 ③ 곁이
Does ㄷ or ㅌ change to ㅈ or ㅊ? Write Yes or No and the sound: ① 같아요 ② 겉이 ③ 밭을
Choose the right sound: ① 팥이 → [파티] / [파치] ② 밑에 → [미테] / [미체] ③ 가을걷이 → [가을거디] / [가을거지]
Write the whole sentence as it sounds: ① 솥이 작아요. ② 같이 놀아요. ③ 맏이 누구예요?
Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 해돋이 ② 붙이다 ③ 밭이
Does ㄷ or ㅌ change to ㅈ or ㅊ? Write Yes or No and the sound: ① 굳이 ② 솥에 ③ 같이
answers: ① No — [가타요] ② Yes — [거치] ③ No — [바틀]
① [소치 자가요] ② [가치 노라요] ③ [마지 누구예요]
① Yes — [구지] ② No — [소테] ③ Yes — [가치]
